panels.title: Credential Control — Activation Pending
panels.description: Accurate production state: secure credential control has source implementation but is not activated in production.

options.content:
## Credential Control is not currently active

The secure Credential Control source was implemented, but production activation was intentionally left **blocked on a one-time OpenBao administrative bootstrap**. The required Grafana datasource jason-credential-control is not currently installed, and the credential-control service is not present in the active source tree.

**Current state:** Not available for credential add/rotation from Grafana.

No credential write should be attempted from this dashboard until the dedicated least-privilege OpenBao policy/AppRole is bootstrapped, the credential-control service is deployed, the datasource bearer token is stored in Grafana secure datasource storage, and controlled acceptance testing is completed.

This status replaces the previously exposed but nonfunctional credential form so the dashboard reflects the actual production state.
